title: David Ellison just brought in a co-CEO to run his new empire: Meet Ynon Kreiz
summary: Ynon Kreiz has been appointed as co-CEO of Skydance, addressing governance structure as David Ellison's company prepares for a major merger. This appointment signals how Ellison plans to manage leadership of his new media and entertainment empire.
content: Ynon Kreiz's appointment as co-CEO of Skydance answers a key governance question for Ellison's soon-to-be-merged company.

zh.title: 大卫·埃里森为其新帝国引入联合首席执行官：认识伊农·克雷兹
zh.summary: 伊农·克雷兹被任命为天舞公司联合首席执行官,以应对大卫·埃里森旗下公司在准备重大并购时的治理结构问题。此任命表明埃里森计划如何管理其新媒体娱乐帝国的领导层。

title: Tesla’s Cybercab had a rocky first month in Austin. Now comes the hard part: expanding
summary: Tesla's Cybercab autonomous taxi service faced challenges during its first month operating in Austin, marking a critical test for Elon Musk's pivot beyond traditional auto sales. The success of expanding this service is central to Tesla's strategic shift toward autonomous transportation.
content: Elon Musk's effort to move beyond auto sales largely relies on the success of his company's Cybercab, which launched in Austin a month ago.

zh.title: 特斯拉Cybercab在奥斯汀的首月举步维艰。现在来了最难的部分：扩展
zh.summary: 特斯拉的Cybercab自动出租车服务在奥斯汀运营的首月面临挑战,对埃隆·马斯克超越传统汽车销售的转型构成重要考验。扩展该服务的成功对特斯拉向自动驾驶运输战略转变至关重要。

title: These companies look set to face high-profile hearings and other scrutiny if Democrats win the House
summary: Washington law and lobbying firms are advising corporations to prepare for increased congressional scrutiny if Democrats gain House control in the upcoming midterm elections. Historical patterns suggest the party holding the White House typically loses congressional seats during midterms.
content: Law and lobbying firms in Washington, D.C., are telling companies to prepare for a new level of scrutiny, since most modern midterm elections result in some loss of congressional control for the party that holds the White House.

zh.title: 若民主党赢得众议院,这些公司可能面临高调听证和其他审查
zh.summary: 华盛顿律师事务所和游说公司建议企业为民主党在即将举行的中期选举中获得众议院控制权后可能面临的国会审查做好准备。历史模式表明,执政党通常在中期选举中失去国会席位。

title: 'Handful' of G20 countries reject U.S. stance on excess industrial capacity
summary: A small minority of G20 nations have rejected the U.S. position on industrial overcapacity, following the Trump administration's implementation of tariffs ranging from 10% to 12.5% on 59 countries. This disagreement highlights growing trade tensions at the international level.
content: The rejection from the vast majority of G20 countries follows the Trump administration's imposition of tariffs of 10% or 12.5% on goods from 59 countries.

zh.title: G20中"少数派"国家拒绝美国工业产能过剩立场
zh.summary: 在特朗普政府对59个国家实施10%至12.5%关税后，少数G20国家拒绝了美国关于工业产能过剩的立场。这一分歧反映了国际贸易紧张局势的加剧。

title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked pilot with axe, attempted 'terrorist' attack, UAE says
summary: A Flydubai co-pilot allegedly attacked the pilot with a crash axe inside the cockpit and attempted to seize control of the aircraft, according to UAE authorities. The incident represents a serious security breach and potential threat to passenger safety.
content: The co-pilot attacked the pilot inside the cockpit with a crash axe and attempted to take control of the aircraft, the UAE prosecutor general said.

zh.title: 迪拜航空副驾驶用斧头攻击机长，阿联酋称为"恐怖"袭击
zh.summary: 根据阿联酋当局，迪拜航空副驾驶涉嫌在驾驶舱内用应急斧攻击机长并试图夺取飞机控制权。这起事件构成严重的安全漏洞和对乘客安全的潜在威胁。

title: New baby bank 'open to everybody'
summary: A new facility is providing essential baby and children's items for free to families in need. The service aims to support households struggling with rising costs of childcare and parenting expenses.
content: The facility offers essential items for free, including clothes for babies and small children.

zh.title: 新婴儿物资库"向所有人开放"
zh.summary: 一个新设施为有需要的家庭免费提供必需的婴儿和儿童用品。该服务旨在帮助那些面临育儿成本上升困难的家庭。

title: Top McKinsey executive reveals Asian owner-CEOs' secrets to success
summary: Gautam Kumra, Asia chairman at McKinsey & Co., has researched and identified key qualities that distinguish Asia's most successful owner-CEOs. The findings offer insights into leadership and business practices in one of the world's most dynamic regions.
content: Gautam Kumra, Asia chairman at consultancy McKinsey & Co., researched the qualities of Asia's best owner-CEOs.

zh.title: 麦肯锡高管揭示亚洲老板型首席执行官的成功秘诀
zh.summary: 麦肯锡亚洲主席高塔姆·库姆拉研究并确定了亚洲最成功的老板型首席执行官的关键特质。这些研究结果为全球最具活力地区之一的领导力和商业实践提供了见解。

title: Rising energy costs add to cost of living for Northern Ireland's consumers
summary: Northern Ireland households are facing increased financial pressure as energy price hikes take effect. The rising costs compound existing cost-of-living challenges for consumers in the region.
content: Households across Northern Ireland face increasing pressure on the cost of living as energy price hikes have come into effect.

zh.title: 不断上升的能源成本加剧北爱尔兰消费者的生活负担
zh.summary: 北爱尔兰家庭随着能源价格上涨的实施而面临增加的财务压力。这些成本上升加重了该地区消费者现有的生活成本压力。

title: America’s data center fight is a preview of what's to come for the rest of the world
summary: Disputes over data center expansion in the U.S. are increasingly mirroring global resistance to AI infrastructure development in Europe and Asia. Communities worldwide are raising concerns about the rising costs and resource demands of the AI boom.
content: America’s fight over data centers is going global. Communities across Europe and Asia  are pushing back over the rising costs of the AI infrastructure boom.

zh.title: 美国数据中心之争预示全球即将面临的局面
zh.summary: 美国数据中心扩张的争议越来越多地反映了欧洲和亚洲对人工智能基础设施发展的全球抵触。全球各地社区对人工智能热潮带来的成本上升和资源需求提出了关切。

title: Suppliers pile pressure on government over energy bills
summary: Trade body Energy UK is urging immediate government action to support households facing higher energy bills this winter. The supplier sector is pressuring policymakers to address the affordability crisis affecting consumers.
content: Immediate action is needed to help households struggling with bills this winter, says trade body Energy UK.

zh.title: 供应商向政府施压能源账单问题
zh.summary: 能源行业组织Energy UK敦促政府立即采取行动，支持今年冬天面临能源账单上升的家庭。供应商部门正在向政策制定者施压，要求解决影响消费者的负担能力危机。
